@@ -9,8 +9,8 @@ An expression is a sum or difference of terms.
 
 ```lr
 Expr
-  : Expr `+` Term   {% \l _ r -> Add l r %}
-  | Expr `-` Term   {% \l _ r -> Sub l r %}
+  : Expr '+' Term   {% \l _ r -> Add l r %}
+  | Expr '-' Term   {% \l _ r -> Sub l r %}
   | Term            {% \t -> t %}
 ```
 
@@ -22,8 +22,8 @@ A term is a product or quotient of factors.
 
 ```lr
 Term
-  : Term `*` Factor {% \l _ r -> Mul l r %}
-  | Term `/` Factor {% \l _ r -> Div l r %}
+  : Term '*' Factor {% \l _ r -> Mul l r %}
+  | Term '/' Factor {% \l _ r -> Div l r %}
   | Factor          {% \f -> f %}
 ```
 
@@ -35,7 +35,7 @@ A factor is a number or a parenthesised expression.
 
 ```lr
 Factor
-  : `(` Expr `)`    {% \_ e _ -> e %}
+  : '(' Expr ')'    {% \_ e _ -> e %}
   | NUMBER          {% \n -> Lit n %}
 ```
 
@@ -46,8 +46,8 @@ Factor
 Earlier declarations bind more loosely than later ones.
 
 ```lr precedence
-%left `+` `-`
-%left `*` `/`
+%left '+' '-'
+%left '*' '/'
 ```
